name: prepare-work
description: Prepare issues for implementation through investigation and issue updates; return only a single-line issue list.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare issues and return a single-line issue list.
interface.longDescription: Investigate mainline blockers, resolve actionable design and environment questions, and persist implementation-ready scope and evidence in issues without implementing production changes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge-steward-prepare-work to prepare actionable issues and return only a single-line issue list.
